description: The plot illustrates the training loss of two models as a function of computational cost measured in TFLOPs (tera floating-point operations), with the x-axis spanning from 0.00 to 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs on a linear scale and the y-axis showing loss values ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, also on a linear scale. The purple line with triangle markers, labeled “Vanilla,” represents the baseline model and shows a steady decline in loss from approximately 2.78 at 0 TFLOPs to about 2.50 at 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs. The red line with circular markers, whose label is obscured by a gray rectangle, starts at a similar loss of ~2.78 and decreases more steeply, reaching ~2.48 at 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs. A green dashed box highlights a region near 1.00 × 10⁹ TFLOPs, annotated with “1.28×,” indicating a performance or efficiency comparison point between the two models at that computational budget. Both lines exhibit diminishing returns as TFLOPs increase, with the red line consistently achieving lower loss than the purple line across the entire range.
